evals.name: plan-only-task-graph
evals.prompt: Plan-only: read the feature plan. Produce a compact manifest summary, task dependency order, lane assignment, and two bounded worker briefs. Do not edit source files, create worktrees, commit, or use any orchestration skill.
evals.expected_output: Keeps plan-only authority, identifies Task 2 as dependent on Task 1, and gives bounded briefs without pasting the whole plan.

evals.name: conflict-preflight
evals.prompt: Preflight the conflicting input fixture without using an orchestration skill. Do not dispatch a worker. Report the exact conflict, why implementation must pause, and the owner decision required.
evals.expected_output: Stops before mutation and identifies the incompatible public signature requirements.

evals.name: multi-lane-review-policy
evals.prompt: Explain how you would execute two independent implementation tasks with Pi sessions, worktrees, commits, proportional validation, and optional persistent architecture/domain/quality peers. Include supervised and autonomous integration differences. Do not modify files and do not use an orchestration skill.
evals.expected_output: Uses native subagents for lifecycle, intercom only for named read-only peers, one writer per worktree, one new-test/existing-check/no-new-test obligation per validation unit, and no duplicate evidence. Adaptive review means parent inspection for low risk, one candidate review for normal risk, and immediate plus candidate review for high-risk or dependency-defining work. Findings pass all five gates (named requirement/rule, change-caused or worsened, reachable, material, proportionate), including realistic security and named test scenarios. Parent dispositions before repair; one fix pass and one delta recheck, no third round or budget reset at candidate assembly. Publication remains separately gated.

evals.name: managed-lifecycle-native-acceptance
evals.prompt: Executable native acceptance run (live execution currently PENDING): create a disposable throwaway Git repository for this evaluation — never use a real project — and use the orchestrate-implementation skill in autonomous mode with native Pi subagent tooling to execute fixtures/managed-lifecycle.md end to end (disposable candidate assembly is authorized; target integration is not): discover agents, pin the collision-checked named base, launch a small managed mutation worker from the named baseRef, allow normal worker finalization, move the parent HEAD, reconstruct and review the lane from the durable handoff patch and digest, launch a fresh fix worker and reconstruct its complete replacement patch from the same pinned base, then record a registered candidate handoff for merge-worktree. No push, PR, deploy, or release. Report BLOCKED with the exact error if any native prerequisite is unavailable; never fall back to a CLI or foreground mode.
evals.expected_output: Either a live PASS with every declared evidence field populated (runtime version, discovered agents, run/lane ids, named base ref and resolved SHA, patch path and digest, worker-reported tree/cleanliness, finalization and cleanup state, parent movement, reconstructed review ref/sha/tree and exact review range with verdict, replacement digest with preserved prior review SHA and exact delta recheck endpoints, registered candidate path/base/head and handoff fields), or a fail-closed BLOCKED report naming the exact infrastructure blocker. Moved-base and digest-mismatch refusals create no review resources; corrupt-artifact and wrong-tree refusals create no reconstruction commit and preserve diagnostic artifacts. Failed required assertions produce FAIL; an owner-selected supervised pause produces AWAITING APPROVAL. Offline suite success is never substituted for this fixture. No CLI fallback or unrelated-project mutation is allowed; native managed worktrees and session artifacts outside the disposable root are permitted only with recorded paths and ownership. The live status stays explicitly PENDING until actually executed.

evals.name: review-guardrail-scenarios
evals.prompt: Read fixtures/review-guardrails.md. Run each scenario once using the full inline reviewer contract from references/pi-dispatch.md pasted into every fresh reviewer task. A and C are independent reviews; B is parent disposition before repair; D is the single fix recheck. No repository mutation or extra review rounds. Report actual outputs and any unmet expectation, not a predicted success.
evals.expected_output: A passes with security: n/a and no test demand. B rejects stolen-secret, hostile-admin, and impossible-coverage pseudo-findings, hands the large migration to the human, and leaves missing auth facts unverified. C is fix-first for the wrong result and named-export violation. D passes without reopening settled scope; unresolved findings require human input, never a third round. Contract-text checks are distinguished from model behavior.
